name: Problem4.boxPlusCoeff_comm
statement:
lemma boxPlusCoeff_comm (n : ℕ) (a b : ℕ → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    boxPlusCoeff n a b k = boxPlusCoeff n b a k

name: Problem4.boxPlusConv_comm
statement:
lemma boxPlusConv_comm (n : ℕ) (a b : ℕ → ℝ) :
    boxPlusConv n a b = boxPlusConv n b a

name: Problem4.choose_div_descFactorial
statement:
lemma choose_div_descFactorial (n k s : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ n) (hs : s ≤ k) :
    ((n - k + s).choose s : ℝ) / (n.descFactorial k : ℝ) =
    1 / ((s.factorial : ℝ) * (n.descFactorial (k - s) : ℝ))

name: Problem4.coeff_polyBoxPlus_uniform
statement:
lemma coeff_polyBoxPlus_uniform (n : ℕ) (q : ℝ[X]) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ (p₁ p₂ : ℝ[X]) (δ : ℝ), 0 < δ →
      (∀ k, |p₁.coeff k - p₂.coeff k| ≤ δ) →
      ∀ k, |(polyBoxPlus n p₁ q).coeff k - (polyBoxPlus n p₂ q).coeff k| ≤ C * δ

name: Problem4.descFactorial_eq_div
statement:
lemma descFactorial_eq_div (n k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ n) :
    (n.descFactorial k : ℝ) = (n.factorial : ℝ) / ((n - k).factorial : ℝ)

name: Problem4.descFactorial_ne_zero_real
statement:
lemma descFactorial_ne_zero_real (n k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ n) :
    (n.descFactorial k : ℝ) ≠ 0

name: Problem4.descFactorial_split
statement:
lemma descFactorial_split (n k s : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ n) (hs : s ≤ k) :
    n.descFactorial k = n.descFactorial (k - s) * (n - k + s).descFactorial s

name: Problem4.factorial_ne_zero_real
statement: lemma factorial_ne_zero_real (n : ℕ) : (n.factorial : ℝ) ≠ 0

name: Problem4.natDegree_comp_X_sub_C_le
statement:
lemma natDegree_comp_X_sub_C_le (p : ℝ[X]) (a : ℝ) :
    (p.comp (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C a)).natDegree ≤ p.natDegree

name: Problem4.natDegree_polyBoxPlus_le
statement:
lemma natDegree_polyBoxPlus_le (n : ℕ) (p q : ℝ[X]) :
    (polyBoxPlus n p q).natDegree ≤ n

name: Problem4.polyBoxPlus_coeff_top
statement:
lemma polyBoxPlus_coeff_top (n : ℕ) (p q : ℝ[X])
    (hp_monic : p.Monic) (hq_monic : q.Monic)
    (hp_deg : p.natDegree = n) (hq_deg : q.natDegree = n) :
    (polyBoxPlus n p q).coeff n = 1

name: Problem4.polyBoxPlus_comm
statement:
lemma polyBoxPlus_comm (n : ℕ) (p q : ℝ[X]) :
    polyBoxPlus n p q = polyBoxPlus n q p

name: Problem4.polyBoxPlus_monic
statement:
lemma polyBoxPlus_monic (n : ℕ) (p q : ℝ[X])
    (hp_monic : p.Monic) (hq_monic : q.Monic)
    (hp_deg : p.natDegree = n) (hq_deg : q.natDegree = n) :
    (polyBoxPlus n p q).Monic

name: Problem4.polyBoxPlus_natDegree
statement:
lemma polyBoxPlus_natDegree (n : ℕ) (p q : ℝ[X])
    (hp_monic : p.Monic) (hq_monic : q.Monic)
    (hp_deg : p.natDegree = n) (hq_deg : q.natDegree = n) :
    (polyBoxPlus n p q).natDegree = n

name: Problem4.boxPlusConv_congr
statement:
lemma boxPlusConv_congr (n : ℕ) (a a' b b' : ℕ → ℝ) (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ n)
    (ha : ∀ i, i ≤ k → a i = a' i) (hb : ∀ j, j ≤ k → b j = b' j) :
    boxPlusConv n a b k = boxPlusConv n a' b' k

name: Problem4.coeff_rPoly
statement:
lemma coeff_rPoly (p : ℝ[X]) (n j : ℕ) :
    (rPoly n p).coeff j = (1 / (n : ℝ)) * ((↑j + 1) : ℝ) * p.coeff (j + 1)

name: Problem4.derivative_boxPlus
statement:
lemma derivative_boxPlus (n : ℕ) (p q : ℝ[X]) :
    rPoly n (polyBoxPlus n p q) = polyBoxPlus (n - 1) (rPoly n p) (rPoly n q)

name: Problem4.derivative_boxPlus_coeff_identity
statement:
lemma derivative_boxPlus_coeff_identity
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (a b : ℕ → ℝ) (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ n - 1) :
    (↑(n - k) : ℝ) / ↑n * boxPlusConv n a b k =
    boxPlusConv (n - 1) (fun j ↦ (↑(n - j) : ℝ) / ↑n * a j)
                        (fun j ↦ (↑(n - j) : ℝ) / ↑n * b j) k

name: Problem4.derivative_prod_linear
statement:
lemma derivative_prod_linear (m : ℕ) (a : Fin m → ℝ) :
    derivative (∏ j : Fin m, (X - C (a j))) =
    ∑ j : Fin m, ∏ i ∈ Finset.univ.erase j, (X - C (a i))

name: Problem4.factorial_pred_mul_real
statement:
lemma factorial_pred_mul_real (m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
    (m.factorial : ℝ) = (m : ℝ) * ((m - 1).factorial : ℝ)

name: Problem4.monic_derivative_eval_eq_prod
statement:
lemma monic_derivative_eval_eq_prod (m : ℕ) (q : ℝ[X]) (μ : Fin m → ℝ)
    (hq_monic : q.Monic) (hq_deg : q.natDegree = m)
    (hq_roots : ∀ i, q.IsRoot (μ i)) (hμ_inj : Function.Injective μ) (i : Fin m) :
    q.derivative.eval (μ i) = ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, (μ i - μ j)

name: Problem4.monic_eq_nodal
statement:
lemma monic_eq_nodal (m : ℕ) (q : ℝ[X]) (μ : Fin m → ℝ)
    (hq_monic : q.Monic) (hq_deg : q.natDegree = m)
    (hq_roots : ∀ i, q.IsRoot (μ i)) (hμ_inj : Function.Injective μ) :
    q = Lagrange.nodal Finset.univ μ

name: Problem4.nested_sum_eq_distinctTriples
statement:
lemma nested_sum_eq_distinctTriples (m : ℕ) (f : Fin m → Fin m → Fin m → ℝ) :
    ∑ i : Fin m, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, ∑ k ∈ (Finset.univ.erase i).erase j,
      f i j k =
    ∑ t ∈ distinctTriples m, f t.1 t.2.1 t.2.2

name: Problem4.partial_fraction_sum_eq_zero_corrected
statement:
lemma partial_fraction_sum_eq_zero_corrected
    (m : ℕ) (hm : 2 ≤ m) (q : ℝ[X]) (μ : Fin m → ℝ)
    (hq_monic : q.Monic)
    (hq_deg : q.natDegree = m)
    (hq_roots : ∀ i, q.IsRoot (μ i))
    (hμ_inj : Function.Injective μ)
    (f : ℝ[X]) (hf_deg : f.natDegree + 2 ≤ m) :
    ∑ i, f.eval (μ i) / q.derivative.eval (μ i) = 0

name: Problem4.partial_fraction_sum_leadingCoeff
statement:
lemma partial_fraction_sum_leadingCoeff
    (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (q : ℝ[X]) (μ : Fin m → ℝ)
    (hq_monic : q.Monic)
    (hq_deg : q.natDegree = m)
    (hq_roots : ∀ i, q.IsRoot (μ i))
    (hμ_inj : Function.Injective μ)
    (f : ℝ[X]) (hf_deg : f.natDegree = m - 1) :
    ∑ i, f.eval (μ i) / q.derivative.eval (μ i) = f.leadingCoeff

name: Problem4.polyToCoeffs_rPoly
statement:
lemma polyToCoeffs_rPoly (p : ℝ[X]) (n k : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (hk : k ≤ n - 1) :
    polyToCoeffs (rPoly n p) (n - 1) k =
    (↑(n - k) : ℝ) / (↑n : ℝ) * polyToCoeffs p n k

name: Problem4.sum_distinct_triples_eq_zero
statement:
lemma sum_distinct_triples_eq_zero (m : ℕ) (μ : Fin m → ℝ)
    (hμ_inj : Function.Injective μ) :
    ∑ t ∈ distinctTriples m,
      (1 : ℝ) / ((μ t.1 - μ t.2.1) * (μ t.1 - μ t.2.2)) = 0

name: Problem4.sum_lagrangeBasis_eq_derivative
statement:
lemma sum_lagrangeBasis_eq_derivative
    (m : ℕ) (rp : ℝ[X]) (critPtsP : Fin m → ℝ)
    (hrp_monic : rp.Monic)
    (hrp_deg : rp.natDegree = m)
    (hrp_roots : ∀ j, rp.IsRoot (critPtsP j))
    (hν_inj : Function.Injective critPtsP) :
    ∑ j, lagrangeBasis rp (critPtsP j) = rp.derivative

name: Problem4.triple_reciprocal_sum_zero
statement:
lemma triple_reciprocal_sum_zero (a b c : ℝ) (hab : a ≠ b) (hbc : b ≠ c) (hac : a ≠ c) :
    1 / ((a - b) * (a - c)) + 1 / ((b - a) * (b - c)) + 1 / ((c - a) * (c - b)) = 0

name: Problem4.convex_im_eq_zero
statement: lemma convex_im_eq_zero : Convex ℝ {z : ℂ | z.im = 0}

name: Problem4.derivative_zeros_between_roots
statement:
lemma derivative_zeros_between_roots (p : ℝ[X]) (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (α : Fin n → ℝ) (hα_strict : StrictMono α)
    (hα_roots : ∀ i, p.IsRoot (α i)) :
    ∃ (ν : Fin (n - 1) → ℝ), StrictMono ν ∧
      (∀ i, p.derivative.IsRoot (ν i)) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin (n - 1),
        α ⟨i.val, by omega⟩ < ν i ∧
        ν i < α ⟨i.val + 1, by omega⟩)

name: Problem4.eval_eq_neg_criticalValue_mul_rderiv
statement:
lemma eval_eq_neg_criticalValue_mul_rderiv (f : ℝ[X]) (n : ℕ) (μ : ℝ)
    (hroot : (rPoly n f).IsRoot μ)
    (hderiv_ne : (rPoly n f).derivative.eval μ ≠ 0) :
    f.eval μ = -criticalValue f n μ * (rPoly n f).derivative.eval μ

name: Problem4.poly_ivt_opp_sign
statement:
lemma poly_ivt_opp_sign (f : ℝ[X]) (a b : ℝ) (hab : a < b)
    (hopp : f.eval a * f.eval b < 0) :
    ∃ c, a < c ∧ c < b ∧ f.IsRoot c

name: Problem4.poly_rolle
statement:
lemma poly_rolle (p : ℝ[X]) (a b : ℝ) (hab : a < b)
    (ha : p.IsRoot a) (hb : p.IsRoot b) :
    ∃ c, a < c ∧ c < b ∧ p.derivative.IsRoot c

name: Problem4.poly_root_above
statement:
lemma poly_root_above (f : ℝ[X]) (b : ℝ)
    (hf_monic : f.Monic) (hdeg : 0 < f.natDegree) (hfb : f.eval b < 0) :
    ∃ c, b < c ∧ f.IsRoot c

name: Problem4.boxPlusCoeff_sum_left
statement:
lemma boxPlusCoeff_sum_left {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (n : ℕ) (a : ι → ℕ → ℝ) (b : ℕ → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    boxPlusCoeff n (fun j ↦ ∑ i, a i j) b k =
    ∑ i, boxPlusCoeff n (a i) b k

name: Problem4.boxPlusConv_sum_left
statement:
lemma boxPlusConv_sum_left {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (n : ℕ) (a : ι → ℕ → ℝ) (b : ℕ → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    boxPlusConv n (fun j ↦ ∑ i, a i j) b k =
    ∑ i, boxPlusConv n (a i) b k

name: Problem4.derivative_prod_linear_finset
statement:
lemma derivative_prod_linear_finset {m : ℕ} (a : Fin m → ℝ)
    (S : Finset (Fin m)) :
    Polynomial.derivative (∏ j ∈ S, (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (a j))) =
    ∑ l ∈ S, ∏ k ∈ S.erase l, (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (a k))

name: Problem4.eval_prod_linear_eq'
statement:
lemma eval_prod_linear_eq' {m : ℕ} (a : Fin m → ℝ)
    (S : Finset (Fin m)) (x : ℝ) :
    (∏ j ∈ S, (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (a j))).eval x = ∏ j ∈ S, (x - a j)

name: Problem4.fin_addCases_injective
Problem4.fin_castAdd_or_natAdd
statement:
lemma fin_castAdd_or_natAdd (m n : ℕ) (a : Fin (m + n)) :
    (∃ i : Fin m, a = Fin.castAdd n i) ∨ (∃ j : Fin n, a = Fin.natAdd m j)

name: Problem4.polyBoxPlus_sum
statement:
lemma polyBoxPlus_sum {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (m : ℕ) (f : ι → ℝ[X]) (g : ℝ[X]) :
    polyBoxPlus m (∑ i, f i) g = ∑ i, polyBoxPlus m (f i) g

name: Problem4.polyToCoeffs_sum
statement:
lemma polyToCoeffs_sum {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (f : ι → ℝ[X]) (n k : ℕ) :
    polyToCoeffs (∑ i, f i) n k = ∑ i, polyToCoeffs (f i) n k

name: Problem4.residue_at_critPt_eq_neg_inv_w
statement:
lemma residue_at_critPt_eq_neg_inv_w
    (p : ℝ[X]) (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (ν : ℝ) (hν : (rPoly n p).IsRoot ν)
    (hpν : p.eval ν ≠ 0)
    (hrν : (rPoly n p).derivative.eval ν ≠ 0) :
    p.derivative.derivative.eval ν / (4 * p.eval ν) =
      -(↑n : ℝ) / 4 * (1 / criticalValue p n ν)

name: Problem4.second_derivative_at_root
statement:
lemma second_derivative_at_root (n : ℕ) (μ : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hμ_inj : Function.Injective μ) (i : Fin n) :
    let hp := ∏ j : Fin n, (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (μ j))
    hp.derivative.derivative.eval (μ i) =
      2 * hp.derivative.eval (μ i) *
        (Finset.univ.filter (· ≠ i)).sum (fun j ↦ 1 / (μ i - μ j))

name: Problem4.criticalValue_comp_X_sub_C_at_root
statement:
lemma criticalValue_comp_X_sub_C_at_root (f : ℝ[X]) (n : ℕ) (c μ : ℝ)
    (hroot : (rPoly n f).IsRoot μ) :
    criticalValue (f.comp (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C c)) n (μ + c) =
    criticalValue f n μ

name: Problem4.rPoly_comp_X_sub_C
statement:
lemma rPoly_comp_X_sub_C (n : ℕ) (p : ℝ[X]) (a : ℝ) :
    rPoly n (p.comp (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C a)) =
    (rPoly n p).comp (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C a)

name: Problem4.squarefree_comp_X_sub_C
statement:
lemma squarefree_comp_X_sub_C (p : ℝ[X]) (a : ℝ) (hp : Squarefree p) :
    Squarefree (p.comp (X - C a))

name: Problem4.squarefree_of_prod_distinct_linear
statement:
lemma squarefree_of_prod_distinct_linear (m : ℕ) (roots : Fin m → ℝ)
    (hInj : Function.Injective roots) :
    Squarefree (∏ i : Fin m, (X - C (roots i)))

name: Problem4.monic_eq_prod_roots
statement:
lemma monic_eq_prod_roots (m : ℕ) (q : ℝ[X]) (μ : Fin m → ℝ)
    (hq_monic : q.Monic) (hq_deg : q.natDegree = m)
    (hq_roots : ∀ i, q.IsRoot (μ i)) (hμ_inj : Function.Injective μ) :
    q = ∏ i, (X - C (μ i))

name: Problem4.Kw_pos
statement:
lemma Kw_pos (m : ℕ) (K : Fin m → Fin m → ℝ) (w : Fin m → ℝ)
    (hK_nonneg : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ K i j)
    (hK_row : ∀ i, ∑ j, K i j = 1)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) (i : Fin m) :
    0 < ∑ j, K i j * w j

name: Problem4.harmonic_sum_bound
statement:
lemma harmonic_sum_bound
    (m : ℕ) (wP wQ wConv : Fin m → ℝ)
    (K Ktilde : Fin m → Fin m → ℝ)
    (hK : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ K i j) (hK_row : ∀ i, ∑ j, K i j = 1)
    (hK_col : ∀ j, ∑ i, K i j = 1)
    (hKt : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ Ktilde i j) (hKt_row : ∀ i, ∑ j, Ktilde i j = 1)
    (hKt_col : ∀ j, ∑ i, Ktilde i j = 1)
    (hwP : ∀ i, 0 < wP i) (hwQ : ∀ i, 0 < wQ i)
    (hdecomp : ∀ i, wConv i = ∑ j, K i j * wP j + ∑ j, Ktilde i j * wQ j) :
    ∑ i, 1 / wConv i ≤
      (∑ i, 1 / wP i) * (∑ i, 1 / wQ i) / ((∑ i, 1 / wP i) + (∑ i, 1 / wQ i))

name: Problem4.jensen_doubly_stochastic
statement:
lemma jensen_doubly_stochastic
    (m : ℕ) (K : Fin m → Fin m → ℝ)
    (w : Fin m → ℝ)
    (hK_nonneg : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ K i j)
    (hK_row : ∀ i, ∑ j, K i j = 1)
    (hK_col : ∀ j, ∑ i, K i j = 1)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) :
    ∑ i, 1 / (∑ j, K i j * w j) ≤ ∑ i, 1 / w i

name: Problem4.weighted_harmonic_le_sum
statement:
lemma weighted_harmonic_le_sum {m : ℕ} (a w : Fin m → ℝ)
    (ha_nonneg : ∀ j, 0 ≤ a j) (ha_sum : ∑ j, a j = 1)
    (hw : ∀ j, 0 < w j) :
    1 / (∑ j, a j * w j) ≤ ∑ j, a j / w j

name: Problem4.eval_eq_lc_mul_prod_roots
statement:
lemma eval_eq_lc_mul_prod_roots (p : Polynomial ℂ) (a : ℂ) :
    p.eval a = p.leadingCoeff * (p.roots.map (fun r ↦ a - r)).prod

name: Problem4.leadingCoeff_perturbation_bound
statement:
lemma leadingCoeff_perturbation_bound {f g : Polynomial ℂ} {c : ℂ}
    (hf_monic : f.Monic)
    (hc : ‖c * g.coeff f.natDegree‖ ≤ 1 / 2)
    (hnd : (f + C c * g).natDegree = f.natDegree) :
    1 / 2 ≤ ‖(f + C c * g).leadingCoeff‖

name: Problem4.monic_natDegree_pos_of_isRoot
statement:
lemma monic_natDegree_pos_of_isRoot {f : Polynomial ℂ}
    (hf : f.Monic) {a : ℂ} (ha : f.IsRoot a) : 1 ≤ f.natDegree

name: Problem4.natDegree_add_C_mul_le
statement:
lemma natDegree_add_C_mul_le (f g : Polynomial ℂ) (c : ℂ)
    (hg : g.natDegree ≤ f.natDegree) :
    (f + C c * g).natDegree ≤ f.natDegree

name: Problem4.natDegree_perturbation_eq
statement:
lemma natDegree_perturbation_eq {f g : Polynomial ℂ} {c : ℂ}
    (hf_monic : f.Monic) (hg_deg : g.natDegree ≤ f.natDegree)
    (hc : ‖c * g.coeff f.natDegree‖ < 1) :
    (f + C c * g).natDegree = f.natDegree

name: Problem4.norm_eval_eq
statement:
lemma norm_eval_eq (p : Polynomial ℂ) (a : ℂ) :
    ‖p.eval a‖ = ‖p.leadingCoeff‖ * ‖(p.roots.map (fun r ↦ a - r)).prod‖

name: Problem4.polynomial_root_perturbation
statement:
theorem polynomial_root_perturbation
    (f g : Polynomial ℂ) (hf_monic : f.Monic) (hg_deg : g.natDegree ≤ f.natDegree)
    (a : ℂ) (hfa : f.IsRoot a) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ c : ℂ, ‖c‖ ≤ δ →
      ∃ z : ℂ, (f + C c * g).IsRoot z ∧ ‖z - a‖ < ε

name: Problem4.eval_div_deriv_pos_of_rolle_interlace
statement:
lemma eval_div_deriv_pos_of_rolle_interlace (m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m)
    (f g : ℝ[X])
    (hf_monic : f.Monic) (hf_deg : f.natDegree = m - 1)
    (hg_monic : g.Monic) (hg_deg : g.natDegree = m)
    (ξ : Fin (m - 1) → ℝ) (μ : Fin m → ℝ)
    (hξ_strict : StrictMono ξ) (hμ_strict : StrictMono μ)
    (hξ_roots : ∀ k, f.IsRoot (ξ k))
    (hμ_roots : ∀ i, g.IsRoot (μ i))
    -- Rolle interlacing: μ₀ < ξ₀ < μ₁ < ξ₁ < ... < ξ_{m-2} < μ_{m-1}
    (hInterlace : ∀ k : Fin (m - 1),
      μ ⟨(k : ℕ), by omega⟩ < ξ k ∧ ξ k < μ ⟨(k : ℕ) + 1, by omega⟩)
    (i : Fin m) :
    0 < f.eval (μ i) / g.derivative.eval (μ i)

name: Problem4.RPoly_boxPlus_eq_boxPlus_rPoly
statement:
lemma RPoly_boxPlus_eq_boxPlus_rPoly
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) (p q : ℝ[X])
    (hp_monic : p.Monic) (_hq_monic : q.Monic)
    (hp_deg : p.natDegree = n) (hq_deg : q.natDegree = n)
    (_hCenteredP : p.coeff (n - 1) = 0) :
    polyBoxPlus n (RPoly n p) q = polyBoxPlus (n - 1) (RPoly n p) (rPoly n q)

name: Problem4.RPoly_coeff_n1_eq_zero
statement:
lemma RPoly_coeff_n1_eq_zero (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) (p : ℝ[X])
    (hCenteredP : p.coeff (n - 1) = 0) :
    (RPoly n p).coeff (n - 1) = 0

name: Problem4.RPoly_coeff_n_eq_zero
statement:
lemma RPoly_coeff_n_eq_zero (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) (p : ℝ[X])
    (hp_monic : p.Monic) (hp_deg : p.natDegree = n) :
    (RPoly n p).coeff n = 0

name: Problem4.boxPlusCoeff_shift_identity
statement:
lemma boxPlusCoeff_shift_identity
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) (a b : ℕ → ℝ) (m : ℕ) (hm : m ≤ n - 1)
    (ha0 : a 0 = 0) :
    boxPlusCoeff n a b (m + 1) =
    boxPlusCoeff (n - 1) (fun k ↦ a (k + 1)) (fun k ↦ (↑(n - k) : ℝ) / ↑n * b k) m

name: Problem4.coeff_RPoly_general
statement:
lemma coeff_RPoly_general (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (f : ℝ[X]) (j : ℕ) :
    (RPoly n f).coeff j = (1 - (↑j : ℝ) / (↑n : ℝ)) * f.coeff j

name: Problem4.polar_boxPlusCoeff
statement:
lemma polar_boxPlusCoeff (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (a b : ℕ → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    (↑k : ℝ) / (↑n : ℝ) * boxPlusCoeff n a b k =
    boxPlusCoeff n (fun i ↦ (↑i : ℝ) / (↑n : ℝ) * a i) b k +
    boxPlusCoeff n a (fun j ↦ (↑j : ℝ) / (↑n : ℝ) * b j) k

name: Problem4.polar_boxPlusConv
statement:
lemma polar_boxPlusConv (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (a b : ℕ → ℝ) (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ n) :
    (↑k : ℝ) / (↑n : ℝ) * boxPlusConv n a b k =
    boxPlusConv n (fun i ↦ (↑i : ℝ) / (↑n : ℝ) * a i) b k +
    boxPlusConv n a (fun j ↦ (↑j : ℝ) / (↑n : ℝ) * b j) k

name: Problem4.polar_decomposition
statement:
lemma polar_decomposition (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (p q : ℝ[X]) :
    RPoly n (polyBoxPlus n p q) =
    polyBoxPlus n (RPoly n p) q + polyBoxPlus n p (RPoly n q)

name: Problem4.polyBoxPlus_C_mul
statement:
lemma polyBoxPlus_C_mul (m : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (f g : ℝ[X]) :
    polyBoxPlus m (Polynomial.C c * f) g = Polynomial.C c * polyBoxPlus m f g

name: Problem4.polyBoxPlus_add_left
statement:
lemma polyBoxPlus_add_left (n : ℕ) (f g h : ℝ[X]) :
    polyBoxPlus n (f + g) h = polyBoxPlus n f h + polyBoxPlus n g h

name: Problem4.polyToCoeffs_RPoly_general
statement:
lemma polyToCoeffs_RPoly_general (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (f : ℝ[X]) (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ n) :
    polyToCoeffs (RPoly n f) n k = (↑k : ℝ) / (↑n : ℝ) * polyToCoeffs f n k

name: Problem4.polyToCoeffs_RPoly_shift
statement:
lemma polyToCoeffs_RPoly_shift (n : ℕ) (_hn : 1 ≤ n) (p : ℝ[X]) (k : ℕ)
    (_hk : k ≤ n - 1) :
    polyToCoeffs (RPoly n p) n (k + 1) = polyToCoeffs (RPoly n p) (n - 1) k

name: Problem4.polyToCoeffs_RPoly_zero
statement:
lemma polyToCoeffs_RPoly_zero (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) (p : ℝ[X])
    (hp_monic : p.Monic) (hp_deg : p.natDegree = n) :
    polyToCoeffs (RPoly n p) n 0 = 0

name: Problem4.one_div_ge_of_le_harmonic_mean
statement:
lemma one_div_ge_of_le_harmonic_mean {a b c : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b)
    (hc : 0 < c) (h : c ≤ a * b / (a + b)) :
    1 / c ≥ 1 / a + 1 / b

name: Problem4.inv_continuous_at_pos
statement:
lemma inv_continuous_at_pos (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ δ > 0, ∀ y : ℝ, 0 < y → |y - a| < δ → |1 / y - 1 / a| < ε

name: Problem4.same_sign_of_close
statement:
lemma same_sign_of_close (a b m : ℝ) (hm : 0 < m) (ha : m ≤ |a|)
    (hclose : |b - a| < m / 2) : 0 < a * b

name: Problem4.sign_change_at_root
statement:
lemma sign_change_at_root (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) (p : ℝ[X])
    (hp_monic : p.Monic) (hp_deg : p.natDegree = n) (_hp_sf : Squarefree p)
    (roots_p : Fin n → ℝ) (hroots_p : StrictMono roots_p)
    (hroots_p_are : ∀ i, p.IsRoot (roots_p i))
    (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    -- δ is smaller than half the minimum gap
    (hδ_small : ∀ j : Fin (n - 1),
      δ < (roots_p ⟨j.val + 1, by omega⟩ - roots_p ⟨j.val, by omega⟩) / 2)
    (i : Fin n) :
    p.eval (roots_p i - δ) * p.eval (roots_p i + δ) < 0

name: Problem4.sorted_roots_in_disjoint_intervals
statement:
lemma sorted_roots_in_disjoint_intervals (n : ℕ) (_hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (centers : Fin n → ℝ) (hcenters : StrictMono centers)
    (radius : ℝ) (_hradius : 0 < radius)
    -- intervals are disjoint
    (hdisjoint : ∀ i j : Fin n, i < j → centers i + radius ≤ centers j - radius)
    -- roots are sorted
    (roots : Fin n → ℝ) (hroots : StrictMono roots)
    -- each interval contains at least one of the given roots
    (hroot_in_interval : ∀ i : Fin n,
      ∃ j : Fin n, centers i - radius < roots j ∧ roots j < centers i + radius) :
    ∀ i : Fin n, centers i - radius < roots i ∧ roots i < centers i + radius

name: Problem4.coeff_mul_X_sub_C_succ
statement:
lemma coeff_mul_X_sub_C_succ (p : ℝ[X]) (a : ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    (p * (X - C a)).coeff (k + 1) = p.coeff k - p.coeff (k + 1) * a

name: Problem4.coeff_mul_X_sub_C_zero
statement:
lemma coeff_mul_X_sub_C_zero (p : ℝ[X]) (a : ℝ) :
    (p * (X - C a)).coeff 0 = -(p.coeff 0 * a)

name: Problem4.continuous_prodPoly_coeff
statement:
lemma continuous_prodPoly_coeff (m : ℕ) :
    ∀ k, Continuous (fun r : Fin m → ℝ ↦ (∏ i : Fin m, (X - C (r i))).coeff k)

name: Problem4.perturbed_strictly_mono
statement:
lemma perturbed_strictly_mono (m : ℕ) (rv : Fin m → ℝ) (hrv : Monotone rv)
    (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    StrictMono (fun i : Fin m ↦ rv i + δ * ((i : ℝ) + 1))

name: Problem4.prod_linear_monic
statement:
lemma prod_linear_monic (m : ℕ) (r : Fin m → ℝ) :
    (∏ i : Fin m, (X - C (r i))).Monic

name: Problem4.prod_linear_natDegree
statement:
lemma prod_linear_natDegree (m : ℕ) (r : Fin m → ℝ) :
    (∏ i : Fin m, (X - C (r i))).natDegree = m

name: Problem4.prod_linear_squarefree
statement:
lemma prod_linear_squarefree (m : ℕ) (r : Fin m → ℝ) (hr : Function.Injective r) :
    Squarefree (∏ i : Fin m, (X - C (r i)))

name: Problem6.barrier_gap_pos
statement:
lemma barrier_gap_pos [Nonempty V]
    (M : Matrix V V ℝ) (u u' : ℝ) (hu : u < u')
    (hM : (u • (1 : Matrix V V ℝ) - M).PosDef) :
    0 < barrierPotential u M - barrierPotential u' M

name: Problem6.barrier_potential_decrease
statement:
lemma barrier_potential_decrease
    (M : Matrix V V ℝ) (u u' : ℝ) (hu : u < u')
    (hM : (u • (1 : Matrix V V ℝ) - M).PosDef) :
    barrierPotential u M - barrierPotential u' M ≥
      (u' - u) * ((u' • (1 : Matrix V V ℝ) - M)⁻¹ *
        (u' • (1 : Matrix V V ℝ) - M)⁻¹).trace

name: Problem6.barrier_rearrange
statement:
lemma barrier_rearrange {a b c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c)
    (_ha_nn : 0 ≤ a) (_hb_nn : 0 ≤ b) (ha_lt : a < 1)
    (hbarr : a + b / c ≤ 1) :
    b / (1 - a) ≤ c

name: Problem6.barrier_shift_posDef
statement:
lemma barrier_shift_posDef
    (M : Matrix V V ℝ) (u u' : ℝ) (hu : u < u')
    (hM : (u • (1 : Matrix V V ℝ) - M).PosDef) :
    (u' • (1 : Matrix V V ℝ) - M).PosDef

name: Problem6.eigenvalue_le_trace_of_posSemidef
statement:
lemma eigenvalue_le_trace_of_posSemidef
    (K : Matrix V V ℝ)
    (hK : K.PosSemidef)
    (i : V) :
    hK.isHermitian.eigenvalues i ≤ K.trace

name: Problem6.psd_factorization
statement:
lemma psd_factorization (P : Matrix V V ℝ) (hP : P.PosSemidef) :
    ∃ (N : Matrix V V ℝ), P = Nᴴ * N

name: Problem6.trace_mul_le_of_loewner
statement:
lemma trace_mul_le_of_loewner
    (X Y C : Matrix V V ℝ)
    (hXY : (Y - X).PosSemidef) (hC : C.PosSemidef) :
    (X * C).trace ≤ (Y * C).trace

name: Problem6.trace_mul_nonneg_of_posSemidef
statement:
lemma trace_mul_nonneg_of_posSemidef
    (P Q : Matrix V V ℝ) (hP : P.PosSemidef) (hQ : Q.PosSemidef) :
    0 ≤ (P * Q).trace

name: Problem6.barrier_parameter_bound
statement:
lemma barrier_parameter_bound
    (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 4 ≤ n) :
    let k := n / 4
    let u₀ := ε / 2
    let δ := ε / (n : ℝ)
    let u_k := u₀ + (k : ℝ) * δ
    u_k ≤ 3 * ε / 4 ∧ 3 * ε / 4 < ε

name: Problem6.largest_color_class_bound
statement:
lemma largest_color_class_bound
    (pc : PartialColoring V r) (hr : 0 < r) :
    ∃ γ : Fin r,
      (pc.colored.filter (fun v => pc.color v = γ)).card * r ≥
        pc.colored.card

name: Problem6.graphLaplacian_eq_lapMatrix
statement:
lemma graphLaplacian_eq_lapMatrix (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] :
    graphLaplacian G = G.lapMatrix ℝ

name: Problem6.graphLaplacian_posSemidef
statement:
lemma graphLaplacian_posSemidef (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] :
    (graphLaplacian G).PosSemidef

name: Problem6.inducedSubgraph_le
statement:
lemma inducedSubgraph_le (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (S : Finset V) : inducedSubgraph G S ≤ G

name: Problem6.sqrt_pullback_loewner
statement:
lemma sqrt_pullback_loewner
    (L : Matrix V V ℝ)
    (Lhalf : Matrix V V ℝ)
    (hLhalf_herm : Lhalf.IsHermitian)
    (hLhalf_sq : Lhalf * Lhalf = L)
    (M : Matrix V V ℝ) (u : ℝ)
    (hM : (u • (1 : Matrix V V ℝ) - M).PosSemidef) :
    (u • L - Lhalf * M * Lhalf).PosSemidef

name: Problem6.hermitian_mulVec_zero_of_sq_zero
statement:
lemma hermitian_mulVec_zero_of_sq_zero
    (Lhalf : Matrix V V ℝ) (hLhalf_herm : Lhalf.IsHermitian) (x : V → ℝ)
    (hx : (Lhalf * Lhalf) *ᵥ x = 0) :
    Lhalf *ᵥ x = 0

name: Problem6.normalized_laplacian_eq_proj
statement:
lemma normalized_laplacian_eq_proj
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (Lhalf Lhalf_pinv : Matrix V V ℝ)
    (hLhalf_sq : Lhalf * Lhalf = graphLaplacian G)
    (hMP3 : (Lhalf * Lhalf_pinv) * (Lhalf * Lhalf_pinv) = Lhalf * Lhalf_pinv)
    (hMP4 : Lhalf * Lhalf_pinv = Lhalf_pinv * Lhalf) :
    Lhalf_pinv * graphLaplacian G * Lhalf_pinv = Lhalf * Lhalf_pinv

name: Problem6.proj_le_one
statement:
lemma proj_le_one
    (P : Matrix V V ℝ)
    (hP_herm : P.IsHermitian)
    (hP_idem : P * P = P) :
    ((1 : Matrix V V ℝ) - P).PosSemidef

name: Problem6.psd_sub_sum_le
statement:
lemma psd_sub_sum_le {r : ℕ} (M : Fin r → Matrix V V ℝ) (u : ℝ)
    (hM_psd : ∀ γ, (M γ).PosSemidef)
    (h_total : (u • (1 : Matrix V V ℝ) - ∑ γ : Fin r, M γ).PosSemidef) :
    ∀ γ : Fin r, (u • (1 : Matrix V V ℝ) - M γ).PosSemidef

name: Problem6.psd_resolvent_trace_bound
statement:
lemma psd_resolvent_trace_bound
    (U B : Matrix V V ℝ)
    (hU : U.PosDef) (hB : B.PosSemidef)
    (htrBU_lt : (B * U).trace < 1)
    (_htrBU_nn : 0 ≤ (B * U).trace) :
    (U⁻¹ - B)⁻¹.trace ≤ U.trace + (B * U * U).trace / (1 - (B * U).trace)

name: Problem6.barrier_smw_trace_bound
statement:
lemma barrier_smw_trace_bound
    (M B : Matrix V V ℝ)
    (u u' : ℝ) (hu : u < u')
    (hM_bound : (u • (1 : Matrix V V ℝ) - M).PosDef)
    (hB : B.PosSemidef)
    (htrBU_lt : (B * (u' • (1 : Matrix V V ℝ) - M)⁻¹).trace < 1)
    (htrBU_nn : 0 ≤ (B * (u' • (1 : Matrix V V ℝ) - M)⁻¹).trace)
    (_htrBU2_nn : 0 ≤ (B * (u' • (1 : Matrix V V ℝ) - M)⁻¹ *
      (u' • (1 : Matrix V V ℝ) - M)⁻¹).trace) :
    barrierPotential u' (M + B) ≤
      barrierPotential u' M +
        (B * (u' • (1 : Matrix V V ℝ) - M)⁻¹ *
          (u' • (1 : Matrix V V ℝ) - M)⁻¹).trace /
        (1 - (B * (u' • (1 : Matrix V V ℝ) - M)⁻¹).trace)

name: Problem6.inv_sub_posDef_of_trace_lt_one
statement:
lemma inv_sub_posDef_of_trace_lt_one
    (U B : Matrix V V ℝ)
    (hU : U.PosDef) (hB : B.PosSemidef)
    (htr : (B * U).trace < 1) :
    (U⁻¹ - B).PosDef

name: Problem6.one_sided_barrier
statement:
lemma one_sided_barrier
    (M B : Matrix V V ℝ)
    (u u' : ℝ) (hu : u < u')
    (hM_bound : (u • (1 : Matrix V V ℝ) - M).PosDef)
    (hB : B.PosSemidef)
    (hbarrier : let U := (u' • (1 : Matrix V V ℝ) - M)⁻¹
      (B * U).trace + (B * U * U).trace / (barrierPotential u M - barrierPotential u' M) ≤ 1) :
    barrierPotential u' (M + B) ≤ barrierPotential u M

name: Problem6.cross_edge_diagonal
statement:
lemma cross_edge_diagonal
    (L DS R : Matrix V V ℝ)
    (h_off_diag : ∀ (a b : V), a ≠ b → (L - DS) a b = R a b)
    (h_row_LHS : ∀ a, ∑ b, (L - DS) a b = 0)
    (h_row_RHS : ∀ a, ∑ b, R a b = 0)
    (i : V) :
    (L - DS) i i = R i i

name: Problem6.hermitian_pseudo_inverse_exists
statement:
lemma hermitian_pseudo_inverse_exists
    (M : Matrix V V ℝ) (hM : M.IsHermitian) :
    ∃ (M_pinv : Matrix V V ℝ),
      M_pinv.IsHermitian ∧
      M * M_pinv * M = M ∧
      M_pinv * M * M_pinv = M_pinv ∧
      (M * M_pinv) * (M * M_pinv) = M * M_pinv ∧
      M * M_pinv = M_pinv * M

name: Problem6.unitary_diag_mul
statement:
lemma unitary_diag_mul
    (U : Matrix V V ℝ) (hstarU : (star U : Matrix V V ℝ) * U = 1)
    (f g : V → ℝ) :
    (U * diagonal f * (star U : Matrix V V ℝ)) *
    (U * diagonal g * (star U : Matrix V V ℝ)) =
    U * diagonal (f * g) * (star U : Matrix V V ℝ)
